description: This file contains utility functions for enriching documents with normalized project IDs and updated timestamps, including functions to handle various input formats and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: normalizeProjectId
methods.description: Normalizes various forms of projectId fields to a lowercase string id, handling strings, numbers, and nested object fields.

methods.name: toValidDate
methods.description: Parses a value into a valid Date object if possible, otherwise returns null.

methods.name: computeUpdatedAt
methods.description: Computes the most relevant updated timestamp from a document, considering multiple possible timestamp fields and fallback to ObjectId timestamp.

methods.name: enrichDeployment
methods.description: Enriches a deployment-like document with normalized projectId and updatedAt timestamp, using other utility functions.
